 External evidence Observed 3 Nov 2026 First recorded 3 Nov 2026

# Crusoe changed its H100 list-price range

The published range moved from $5.50 to $7.70 to $5.50 to $8.20 per GPU-hour.

## Why it matters

List-price changes show how public cloud positioning moves across comparable GPU products. Negotiated customer prices may differ.

## Evidence boundary

This is a detected public list-price change, not a transaction price or a daily market quote.
